fact_check_log.claim: Geoscience Australia's sunrise, sunset and twilight calculator works these times out using the National Gazetteer of Australia (linked at claim: geodesyapps.ga.gov.au/sunrise).
The calculator takes a place name or latitude and longitude (including outside Australia), a time zone, and returns sunset and twilight for a single day or a whole year.
Published sunset assumes a flat horizon / ideal horizon (after edit: linked at claim to the GA definitions page).
Sunset is the moment the upper edge of the sun meets an ideal horizon (after edit: linked at claim).
At a venue with hills, cliffs, trees or buildings to the west, the sun drops out of view before the listed time.
End of evening civil twilight: centre of the sun 6 degrees below the horizon; large objects visible, no detail without artificial light.
End of evening nautical twilight: 12 degrees below the horizon; dark for normal practical purposes.
Sunset changes with the season, the latitude and the exact spot (uncited).
If sunset falls before 4.30pm, the ceremony is your golden light (sunset logic error).
US Naval Observatory one-day calculator as a cross-check for venues outside Australia (external link from 02-seo.json; no factual claim beyond the link).

All clock times in the 4pm, 2pm, 3pm, 4.30pm and 5pm timelines and FAQ answers are framed as examples ('for example', 'in these examples', 'a planning example to adapt, not a rule'); no averages or statistics. Planning advice per 03 must_include_coverage.

FAQ cross-references to the example timelines: hair and makeup 9am/10am, photographer 12.30pm/1.30pm, guests 3.30pm, send-off 10.45pm/11pm, gap about 90 minutes with a first look and longer without. All match the lists.
Winter sunset may come before or during a 5pm ceremony (hedged, no time stated; consistent with fact_02 and the advice to check the calculator).

Wedded Advisor lines: plans venue, travel, vendors and payments anywhere in the world; works in your time zone; single point of contact start to finish; fee agreed in writing before work begins; confirms inclusions in writing; quotes in AUD for Australian couples. All from brand-facts 'Claims we can make'; nothing implies the Advisor runs the day or is on the ground.
Wonderland Studio described only as 'our planning app for seating charts and RSVPs'.
